paper_metadata.title: QUANTITATIVE AND QUALITATIVE ASSESSMENT OF AS-CAST MICROSTRUCTURE AND MICROPOROSITY OF c-c0 Co-BASED SUPERALLOYS

evidence.quote: The work is focused on quantitative and qualitative microstructural characterization of selected c-c0 type Co-based superalloys obtained by gravity casting.
